name: DHC award contract repeatable claim
summary: The DHC award implementation (unverified) pays a claim (0x43609f36) from the proxy's pooled DHC without marking the award spent, and a dust re-participation (0xe3db9b54) makes the same award claimable again. The attacker funded awards once with flash-bought DHC, re-claimed them hundreds of times and sold the DHC.
notes: DHC has no market price; the drained DHC (net of the attacker's own award deposits) is valued at the USDT the attacker realised selling it, less its seed purchase (rule 12).

Slot 0x77 (set by 0x779f4cb7 after the upgrade) is not needed: replaying the anchor with it at 0 drains the same. The missing spent-award guard is inferred from the trace; the implementation is unverified.
